integrity: Includes two standalone Python verification scripts, source citations, and precise mathematical limits; the small-case computations are reproducible and independent of the symbolic argument.
scientific_limitations: The equivalence is proved for \(n\ge2\). Pell candidates and the logarithmic count are only necessary conditions; existence of nontrivial collisions is unresolved. The finite verifier checks the range \(n<10000\), while the global reduction is symbolic.
title: Consecutive-collision rigidity for weighted powers of the divisor sum
